judged_text: N+1 credential lookup inside the destination loop in `createAllCalendarEvents` (`packages/core/EventManager.ts:~344`): `prisma.credential.findUnique` executes once per non-organizer host destination whose credential isn't in `this.calendarCredentials`, on every booking, serially compounding latency; batch with a single `prisma.credential.findMany({ where: { id: { in: missingIds } } })` or hydrate all host credentials up front in the caller.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the diff introduces a `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop and, when `destination.credentialId` is set but not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } ... })` inside the loop. This can result in one DB query per destination calendar (per booking) and the awaits make these lookups serial, matching the reported N+1/latency concern. This is a performance/architecture issue rather than a functional defect.
